recorded_before: the first family/ranking measurement (CP17.3 fusion did not exist when this file was committed)
rule: A target is never lowered after a run (C17-LINEAGE). A failed target is reported, repaired in the method, or escalated; never relaxed here.
generator_note: 1.1.0 when the targets were first recorded (f2d3ebb); 1.2.0 adds review cp17-1-a traps before any measurement; 1.3.0 (after measurements) adds the review cp17-234-a traps status_phrasing and abandoned_caller and two golden families, which first failed on the unrepaired method; 1.4.0 adds hidden_markdown (review F7, F8); 1.5.0 adds trivial_files (review F18); 1.6.0 makes hidden_markdown hold a statement and adds tag_characters (review r2 R2-4). Targets unchanged: traps and families are only ever added, a target is never lowered.

metrics.family_pairwise_precision: Of the file pairs PrometheOS puts in one family, the share that one golden family also holds (pairs over golden-family members only).
metrics.family_pairwise_recall: Of the file pairs one golden family holds, the share PrometheOS also puts in one family.
metrics.current_precision: Over golden families whose PrometheOS family has a current member in band decided or supported, the share whose current member is the golden one.
metrics.current_coverage: The share of golden families whose PrometheOS family has a current member in band decided or supported.
metrics.traps_handled: The share of planted traps that are detected as specified or surfaced as unresolved (never silently ranked).
metrics.auto_applied_supersessions: Supersessions or exclusions applied as owner decisions without an owner act (must be zero).
metrics.mtime_decisions: Ranks whose deciding reason is a filesystem modification time (must be zero).
